A '''government office''' on<ref name="New History" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} - Based on corresponding data for [[Halpat system/Legends|Halpat system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Halpat]] was destroyed by rioters<ref name="New History" /> [[Time/Legends|sometime]] by [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> As a result, a maze of ancient passageways underneath the government office was discovered.<ref name="New History" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the two sides in the [[Sith Wars/Legends|ongoing struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to explore the labyrinth underneath where the government office had been.<ref name="New History" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The government office was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "New History" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] expansion to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="New History" />
